chunks: From him, from Ali ibn Asbaat, from Al-'Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) wrote to the Shiites: 'Let those among you who are of age and possess intellect be sympathetic towards those who are ignorant and seekers of leadership, or else my curse will surely befall you all.'
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for the Imam's curse to befall the Shiites according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In this epistle to the Shia community, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) emphasizes the critical duty of the wise and mature to guide the ignorant and those seeking status, framing it as a condition for communal survival. This instruction highlights the Shia concept of *al-nuha* (intellect/maturity) as a social responsibility, warning that neglecting this mentorship invites the Imam's collective curse upon the entire community.
